status: Fixed in current source and frozen runner; formal backlog closeout recorded 2026-09-02
finding: ATM-GOV-0195 surfaced a batch queue-head playbook that instructed batch checkpoint, but batch checkpoint failed because no active batch run existed; a later next --claim switched the same task to normal single-task playbook.
expectedBehavior: The router and playbook should not oscillate between batch and normal for the same active queue-head. If checkpoint is required, next --claim should create or recover the active batch run; if normal close is correct, the preview should not instruct batch checkpoint.
evidenceOrRepro: Historical repro: node atm.mjs next --prompt "Continue active task ATM-GOV-0195..." --json returned channel=batch and checkpointCommand; node atm.mjs batch checkpoint then failed with ATM_BATCH_RUN_MISSING; a later next --claim returned normal. Current source closes that seam: claimNextImportedTask persists writeBatchRun for every promptScope.status=queue before selectPostClaimChannel derives the returned channel, so a batch claim creates the active batch run before it advertises checkpoint. Active batches route next through task-batch-context-active or batch-state-repair-required, never normal. Focused current checks passed on 2026-09-02: tests/cli/next-active-batch-route.test.ts, tests/cli/batch-final-600.test.ts, and packages/cli/src/commands/batch/checkpoint-commit-window-policy.test.ts. Frozen runner source seal is current (next reported syncRequired=false).
followUp: Source repair and frozen runner coverage are current. No further quickfix is required.
